title: Nine Seconds and One Knee
subtitle: 体育与运动 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 体育与运动（生活与学习·运动与健身）
meta: 主题语境：体育与运动（生活与学习·运动与健身）　|　核心词汇：athlete　|　正文 317 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 athlete 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 an ① athlete from the next town ran nine seconds faster than anybody and never ran again. The ② athlete, meaning the person and not the time, was nineteen and had a knee that would not last; an athlete, my grandmother said, is somebody who has agreed to be measured. She said the measuring was the part she disliked.

Every ③ athlete my father admired had stopped young, and he said that was not a coincidence. Their ④ athlete — the one the town paid for — trained on a field that flooded nine times a year; an athlete, my mother said, is the only person whose office is a field. She said the field was under water in March.

My uncle, who was fifty-four and walked to the shop, said he was ⑤ an athlete in retirement, and everybody let it pass. The ⑥ athlete, meaning the profession and not the person, is nine parts boredom and one part nine seconds; an athlete, my father said, is the only worker whose career is shorter than their memory of it. He said the memory lasts eleven times as long.

By 1978 the  athlete had become a coach and the knee had become a story he told at weddings. The ⑦ athlete in the photograph on the wall is running, and he has been running since 1976; an athlete, my mother said, is the only person who is famous for a thing that took nine seconds and a childhood. She said the childhood is the expensive part.

The  athlete I remember is the one who never ran again, whom the town still talks about. An ⑧ athlete, my father said in 1981, is the only person who is paid to be young and is expected to stay grateful afterwards; every athlete, he said, is a body that has been asked a question it can only answer once. He said the answer took nine seconds.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 运动员（一个人）
B. n. 运动员（指人本身，与成绩相对）
C. n. 运动员（指照片上那一位）
D. n. 运动员（比喻：自称的、退役的）
E. n. 运动员（指这个职业）
F. n. 运动员（泛指这类人）
G. n. 运动员（抽象总称）
H. n. 运动员（指镇上出钱培养的那一位）

items.q: an athlete from the next town
The athlete, meaning the person and not the time
An athlete, my father said in 1981

answers.why: athlete 意为“运动员”，1976 年邻镇有一位运动员比任何人都快九秒，此后再也没有跑过。
athlete 指“人本身”，与成绩相对，那位运动员十九岁，有一条撑不了多久的膝盖。
athlete 泛指“运动员这类人”，父亲佩服过的每一位运动员都很年轻就停了，他说那不是巧合。
athlete 指镇上出钱培养的那一位，他们那位运动员在一片一年要淹九次的场地上训练。
athlete 为比喻义，指自称的、退役的“运动员”，五十四岁、走路去商店的叔叔说自己是“退休运动员”，大家都没接话。
athlete 指“这个职业”，与人相对，是九分无聊加一分九秒。
athlete 指照片上那一位，墙上照片里的那位运动员在跑，从 1976 年一直跑到现在。
athlete 为抽象总称，父亲说运动员是唯一被雇来年轻、此后还被指望心怀感激的人。
